arabic_text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ إلهِي مِنْ مُقْتَدِر لاَ يُغْلَبُ، وَذِي أَناة لاَ تَعْجَلُ.
transliteration: falaka al-ḥamdu ilahii min muqtaḍir laa yughlabu wa dhī anāh lā taʿjal
english_text: So Thine is the praise, my God, the All-powerful who is not overcome, and the Possessor of patient waiting who does not hurry!

arabic_text: هَذَا مَقَامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسبوغِ النِّعَمِ، وَقَابَلَهَا بِالتَّقْصِيرِ، وَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّضْيِيْعِ.
transliteration: hādhā maqāmu mani iʿtarafa bisbuwghi anniʿami waqābala-hā bit-taqṣīr, wa shahida ʿalā nafsi-hi bi-t-taḍyīʾ
english_text: This is the station of one who confesses to lavishness of favours, counters them with shortcomings, and bears witness to his own negligence.

arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إلَيْكَ بِالْمُحَمَّدِيَّةِ الرَّفِيعَةِ، وَالْعَلَوِيَّةِ الْبَيْضَآءِ، وَأَتَـوَجَّهُ إلَيْكَ بِهِمَا، تُعِيذَنِيْ مِنْ شَرِّ [كَذَا وَكَذَا] فَإنَّ ذَالِكَ لا يَضِيْقُ عَلَيْكَ فِي وُجْدِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma fainnī ataqarrabu ilayka bil-muḥammadiyyatir-rafiʿah wal-ʿalawiyyatil-bayḍāʾi, wa atawajjahu ilayka bihimā tuʿīẓanī min sharri [kadha wa kadha] fa-inna dhālika la yadiqu ʿalayka fi wujdik
english_text: O God, so I seek nearness to Thee through the elevated rank of Muhammad and the radiant degree of 'Ali, and I turn to Thee through them so that Thou wilt give me refuge from the evil of [so and so], for that will not constrain Thee in Thy wealth,

arabic_text: وَلاَ يَتَكَأدُّكَ فِي قُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ،
transliteration: wa lā yatakadduka fī qudratika wa-anta ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr
english_text: nor trouble Thee in Thy power, and Thou art powerful over everything!

arabic_text: فَهَبْ لِي يا إلهِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَدَوَامِ تَوْفِيقِكَ، مَا أَتَّخِذُهُ سُلَّماً أَعْرُجُ بِهِ إلى رِضْوَانِكَ، وَآمَنُ بِهِ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
transliteration: fahab li ya ilahi min rahmatika wa dawami tawfiqik mā ʾattakhidhuhu sullaman ʿaruj bihī ʾilā riḍwānik wa āmanu bihi min ʿiqābika, yā arḥama al-rāḥimīn
english_text: So give me, my God, by Thy mercy and Thy lasting bestowal of success, that which I may take as a ladder with which to climb to Thy good pleasure and be secure from Thy punishment, O Most merciful of the merciful!
